business_summary.text: Vidya Wires Limited manufactures electrical and industrial winding and conductivity solutions, with a focus on copper and aluminum products for power transmission, renewable energy, and EV infrastructure.

call_points.text: No specific FY27 revenue or margin guidance provided; expects good growth from capacity expansion
Strong demand in power and transmission segment (51% of revenue); new products targeting EV and renewable
New products expected to improve EBITDA per ton; back-to-back hedging insulates from commodity volatility
Global supply chain challenges due to Middle East crisis affecting freight costs

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Income Tax Department has completed Block Assessment vide order dated 27.05.2026 passed under Section 158BC read with Section 143(3) of the Income Tax Act, determining undisclosed income of Rs.2,92,96,111/- and raising a demand of Rs.1,75,77,666/- on ALCU Industries Private Limited (Wholly Owned Subsidiary of the Company). The said Company had filed an appeal against the aforesaid order before the Commissioner of Income-tax (Appeals) on 20.06.2026, which is pending adjudication. Penalty proceedings initiated pursuant to the said assessment are pending, and the subsidiary has requested the Assessing Officer to keep the same in abeyance till disposal of the appeal against the quantum assessment. Separately, the Income Tax Department has issued a notice under Section 143(2) of the Income Tax Act to the said subsidiary for Assessment Year 2025-26, and the assessment proceedings pursuant thereto are currently pending before the Assessing Officer.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of Income-tax, Central Circle-3, Vadodara
tax_litigation.status: As of the quarter ended 30th June, 2026, there has been no change in status since the last announcement (Ongoing)
